name: qwen2_moe_mxfp4_router_experts_shuffled_16x16_model_dim4096_n_routed512_inter_dim256
description: sglang's Qwen2MoeSparseMoeBlock._forward_router_experts on one rank of its TP group, with MXFP4 experts and the MXFP4 shared expert fused into them after the routed ones: the logits hidden_states router_weight^T, rounded to bf16, pick each token's topk experts by descending logit, a tie going to the lower expert id, weighed by the softmax of their logits (the softmax over every expert, renormalized over the chosen ones), and the shared expert by sigmoid(hidden_states shared_gate_weight^T); each expert down(silu(gate(x)) * up(x)) of its MXFP4 weights (fused_moe's: fp4 values at an e8m0 scale per 32), each of its two linears taking its input in MXFP4 as aiter's per_1x32 fused_moe quantizes it (each 1 x 32 block at an e8m0 scale); out is this rank's share of the block's output, which the TP group sums after the call

n_experts.description: Expert slots: the routed experts, then the shared one.

inter_dim.description: Expert intermediate size on this rank.

gate_up_rows.description: w1 rows: gate and up concatenated.

hidden_states.description: The tokens' hidden states, the MoE block's input.

shared_gate_weight.description: shared_expert_gate's weight: the shared expert weighs sigmoid(hidden_states shared_gate_weight^T).

w1.description: Gate-up projection per expert slot on this rank: gate rows, then up rows.

w2.description: Down projection per expert slot on this rank.

out.description: This rank's share of the MoE block's output.
